# Minicuration

Minicuration produces museum-quality reproductions of original paintings on 2.5×3.5-inch trading cards (ACEO format), in two collections. Limited editions are restricted to exactly 50 numbered prints per design and sealed in a rigid magnetic acrylic display case with a standing easel included. Unlimited cards are an open-edition run of archive paintings, not numbered. Every print reproduces a hand-painted original in acrylic, mixed media, and found materials (such as spray paint, ink, joint compound, latex, and epoxy resin) on canvas or wood panel. All work is currently by a single artist, JFeelgood (https://jfeelgood.com). The back of each card carries the artist name, medium, edition number, and the artist's own statement about the work. All prints are on sale for $10 USD through August 31, 2026 (regularly $23 USD); Sweet Dreams is $8 USD.

## What makes Minicuration distinct

- Trading card size (2.5×3.5 inches) — sealed in a rigid magnetic acrylic case that stands on the included easel (the case is a protective display object, not a wallet insert)
- Limited editions: strictly 50 numbered prints per design; no reprints
- Each card ships sealed in a magnetic acrylic collector's case with a display stand
- Reproduces original paintings, not digital art — every print has a physical source work
- Artist statement on the back of every card
- Connects collectors directly to the artist via affordable, physical collectibles
- Sister site: https://jfeelgood.com
